_readme: Equipment strip on the About page (idea 6 in docs/MEDIA_PROPOSAL.md). The client confirmed on 2026-09-16 that the machines in the client photo batch are company-owned, which is what lets the section be titled «معداتنا» / "Our Equipment". "label" and "alt" describe only what is visible in the frame: no counts, no fleet size and no brand names, even where a maker's name is legible on the machine.
